title: ctsegdose-core: patient-specific absorbed organ dose from CT tube-current modulation, using deep-learning organ segmentation and HU-derived density
description:
A Python package (MIT) that takes a CT acquisition from its recorded tube-current modulation to an absorbed organ dose in mGy, made patient-specific by the patient's own anatomy. Organs are segmented from the same series with a deep-learning segmenter; organ mass comes from the measured Hounsfield units rather than from a reference body; the organ-specific weighted CTDIvol of ctdose-core is converted to absorbed dose with CTDIvol-normalised organ-dose coefficients scaled to that patient. Every value carries its formula, its inputs, its assumptions and its source.

No imaging data is redistributed. The public series used are identified in data/PROVENANCE.json by collection, collection DOI, Series Instance UID and licence, and can be re-fetched from The Cancer Imaging Archive by following docs/REPRODUCING_DATA.md.
